harnessDevelopmentNotes: The shell python3 shim had no backend; no Cargo oracle process started. The bundled absolute Python runtime is used.

Initial runner self-test reached its deadline but waited with zero cleanup time, causing a redundant group kill to fail after the owned child was already killed. Fixed by a separate finite cleanup allowance; no Cargo fixture result was produced by this attempt.

semanticFindings.observation: Successful records use the resolved workspace root plus target for the default output. Invoking a virtual member changes default selection to the current package while preserving the shared output root.

Literal explicit a stays a member despite exclude a; literal foo/child also stays despite exclude foo. Glob-expanded crates/a is removed by exclude crates/a. A uniform members-minus-exclude rule would disagree.
exclude foo prevents implicit membership of foo/child but preserves foobar. exclude crates/* does not glob-filter the implicit crates/a dependency in this Cargo version.

Unlisted nested packages and descendants of a literal member are rejected when invoked. An excluded package or package with its own workspace resolves as its own root; ancestor proximity alone cannot establish membership.

All tested dependency table kinds, including inactive target and optional declarations, participate in implicit membership. Explicit members=[] does not disable it; path dependencies are traversed transitively.
An unused workspace dependency or unused patch path is not a membership edge. Inheriting workspace dependency b adds b; an empty virtual workspace with unused declarations stays empty.

An external package with an explicit pointer can share the root workspace, including through a path dependency. Without the pointer, explicit inclusion from the root is rejected, direct external invocation is standalone, and an external path dependency is not a root member.

Nested member roots, a member pointing at another workspace, a pointer to a non-workspace manifest, and simultaneous package.workspace plus workspace are all rejected; declaration paths need native observation and root validation.

default-members changes root package selection, including explicit empty selection, without changing output root. Invalid default-members is rejected at workspace cwd but not inspected as a root default selection when invoked from a valid member.

metadata --no-deps accepts empty virtual workspaces and a dependency membership cycle; this does not prove a build would succeed. Missing literal members, unmatched or invalid member globs and a missing transitive path dependency are rejected. a/../b resolves b in Cargo metadata, independently of SweepX no-follow path support.

limitations: This oracle executes metadata --offline --no-deps only. resolve=null; no dependency graph resolution, build, build script, CLI --target-dir, Trash or product scan was executed.
Results describe pinned Cargo 1.98.0 (797e8a9bc) on this macOS host. Latest Cargo source and other platforms are not evidence for these records.
Captured cwd/env and input bytes are preserved, but disposable fixture paths have been removed after recording. The harness can reconstruct all declared input files.
No atomic filesystem snapshot, exclusive ownership, process inactivity, native SweepX identity compatibility or deletion permission is inferred from Cargo success or target_directory.
No performance measurement was collected or inferred. Cooperative process deadline is 5 seconds; forced cleanup receives a separate finite 2-second wait.
semanticFindings is a later case-indexed reading of the unchanged raw records. Negative cases remain Cargo refusals, not failed oracle collection or ignored product tests.
